title: Shot types
guidance: One flowing present-tense paragraph, under about 200 words.
Start with the main action, then movement and gestures, appearance, environment, camera, lighting and colour.
LTX-2.5 audio: describe ambient sound, put dialogue in quotes with the speaker, name any music.
Pick a shot size first, then a camera movement.

entries.label: Wide establishing shot
entries.prompt: A wide establishing shot shows the whole location and the subject small within it.

entries.label: Medium shot
entries.prompt: A medium shot frames the subject from the waist up.

entries.label: Close-up
entries.prompt: A close-up frames the face, with eyes and small expressions in focus.

entries.label: Extreme close-up
entries.prompt: An extreme close-up fills the frame with a single detail.

entries.label: Over the shoulder
entries.prompt: An over-the-shoulder shot looks past one person toward the other.

entries.label: Two-shot
entries.prompt: A two-shot frames both characters side by side in the same frame.

entries.label: Product hero shot
entries.prompt: A hero shot of the product, centred, filling the frame with space around it.

entries.label: First-person POV
entries.prompt: A first-person point of view, with the viewer's hands visible at the edges of the frame.

entries.label: Low-angle hero
entries.prompt: A low-angle shot looks up at the subject, making them powerful and imposing.
